title: Remove Unreferenced Package.json Scripts
description: Remove all scripts from all package.json files across the complete repo that are not inside launch.json. Make sure that launch.json only calls scripts and has no information about what to execute. Most scripts should be deleted from the main package.json including: "dev", "dev:3dm:ui", "dev:coda-desktop", "dev:elements:ui:storybook", "dev:js:js:sketchpad", "analyze", "fix", "lint", "test", "test:repo", "build", "update", "publish:test", "publish", "benchmark", "pre-commit", "pre-commit:install", "configure", "mcp:inspector". Only keep scripts that are actually referenced in launch.json configurations.
